steps.sub: No iteration needed, for a line

code:
price = 50000 + 120 * sqft + rng.normal(0, 25000, 60)
model = LinearRegression().fit(X, price)
print(model.intercept_.round(0), model.coef_.round(1))
# 45825.0  [119.5]  -- close to the true 50000, 120
caption: Noise stops an exact match -- that's normal, not a bug.

code:
X = sqft.reshape(-1, 1)   # sklearn wants a 2-D array
model.predict([[1500]])   # [225011.]

# every learned value ends in "_": intercept_, coef_
caption: $225,011 predicted for a 1,500 sq ft house.
Real scikit-learn output -- always plot when you can. A picture reveals what a score hides.

eyebrow: How good is the fit? R²
code:
print(round(model.score(X, price), 3))
# 0.949 -- explains ~95% of the variation
caption: Computed on the TRAINING data here -- real evaluation needs a held-out test set (Lesson 7).
